rows.semanticsWitness: The immutable alias fixed point pre-registers every framework authority root and foreign import binding; an identifier absent from that closed environment is local to this server-operation domain, while raw host acquisition is rejected by capability closure.

Only the exact pre-registered Response constructor identity reaches response-constructor; constructing it produces response bytes/outcome authority, never a request, database, storage, or egress capability.
A constructor reached through an imported executable retains foreign-executable provenance; the extractor does not infer a safe result from opaque constructor behavior.

A new-expression is local only after the constructor is neither foreign nor authority-bearing and every argument is free of server authority; capability closure separately rejects raw host acquisition inside the module graph.

The closed member relation grants scope-call only to context.actAs/declareSystemRead/declareSystemWrite; invoking that exact operation returns the narrowed request context and no broader ambient principal.

The closed relation grants scoped-key-call only to stateKey/systemStateKey on a witnessed context; the opaque key is plain result data in this operation lattice and does not expose its storage or principal mint authority.
Object.freeze/seal/preventExtensions are identity-preserving only for exactly one argument; the result keeps that argument's provenance, while every other arity closes at unknown-authority.

Calling the exact Response constructor or a reviewed Response static operation yields response-outcome bytes; it cannot manufacture request, database, storage, or egress authority in the finite relation.

A call result is local only after the callee is outside every closed authority and foreign-executable state; helper authority movement is analyzed independently by the exact same-file helper map and opaque calls close before effect use.

The finite binary transfer returns local only when neither operand carries authority or a foreign executable; any authority operand joins at unknown-authority and a foreign operand remains foreign-executable.
The finite conditional transfer preserves equal branches, joins unequal authority at unknown-authority, preserves foreign-executable, and grants local only when both alternatives are local.

A static property read is projected exclusively through the complete server member relation; unknown or computed authority members default to unknown-authority instead of inheriting a benign receiver label.

The first bounded fallthrough walk skips nested executable scopes and call results but finds any referenced foreign executable in opaque containers; a hit remains foreign-executable rather than being granted local provenance.

The final local grant occurs only after the explicit object-literal implicit-protocol shape test and both bounded fallthrough walks find neither foreign executable nor server authority; otherwise the earlier branch returns foreign-executable or unknown-authority.
